questions.question: Moses told Israel that in the year of release, they must also cancel what foreigners owe them. True or false?
What did Moses tell the Israelites to do for a poor brother in need?

answers.text: Open their hand and loan what he needs
Point him to a richer man in town
Hire him to work for one season

questions.question: After six years of service, what did Moses say Israelites must do for a Hebrew servant in the seventh year?
Moses told Israel to free their Hebrew servants and send them off with plenty. What were they to remember?

answers.text: They were slaves in Egypt and the LORD redeemed them
Freed servants will speak well of their old masters
The nations around them are watching how they live
